title: SREV-190 Winsock ABI function pointer contract
contracts: wsa_defs.h owns local Winsock and IP Helper dynamic function pointer ABI declarations
net.c owns the corresponding Winsock detour entry points installed through SBIEDLL_HOOK
Winsock function pointers must use WSAAPI to preserve provider call convention
IP Helper GetAdaptersAddresses must use WINAPI
socket and WSASocketW must return SOCKET not int
getsockname must receive a writable output address pointer
ConnectEx and AcceptEx extension pointers must return BOOL
ConnectEx detour failure paths must return FALSE not SOCKET_ERROR
runtime proof is required on x86 and x64 Windows
runtime_gate: Windows x86 and x64 build plus Winsock socket connect ConnectEx send recv sendto recvfrom bind-IP proxy and DNS-filter runtime proof
